SELECT 'g1' AS grp, main_cat, COUNT(*) AS n FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat

SELECT grp, main_cat, n FROM (
  SELECT 'g1' AS grp, main_cat, COUNT(*) AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat
) WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY grp, n DESC
SELECT prc, prc_usd, ttl FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL LIMIT 8

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_null, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_usd_null, MIN(prc), MAX(prc), MIN(prc_usd), MAX(prc_usd) FROM items_g2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id
  FROM items_g2 i
  JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  WHERE i.prc_usd > 50
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING COUNT(f.id) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS items_over_50 FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd > 50

SELECT i.ref_id, SUBSTR(i.ttl,1,50) AS title, i.prc_usd, COUNT(f.id) AS reviews, ROUND(AVG(f.rtg),3) AS avg_review_rating
FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE i.prc_usd > 50
GROUP BY i.ref_id
HAVING COUNT(f.id) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
ORDER BY avg_review_rating
